title: VBM = -inf because plotting mixed band_out weighted occupations with an occ>0.5 rule
symptom: plot_compare.py reports VBM = -inf while the underlying KS/EXX/GW files are finite.
root_cause: KS_band_spin_*.dat carry binary 0/1 occupations; band_out carries weighted occupations (e.g. 0.130208) after overwriting; an occ > 0.5 band-edge rule then classifies every band as unoccupied.
minimal_fix: Map occupations to binary (apply_band_out_occupations()) before any band-edge logic; assert finiteness of VBM/CBM in every comparison figure script.
validation: vbm_librpa returns a finite 10.43977 eV after the fix.
avoid: Reading -inf as a physics failure; it is an occupancy-representation mismatch.

parameters.rule: map band_out weighted occupations to binary before occ>0.5 band-edge logic
